confirm.deleteWarning:
This will permanently delete the encrypted content of "{name}" — even if the .locked marker file still exists, it can never again be decrypted with password, Passkey, or recovery key. The data is gone for good; this is not just "removing it from the list".

Are you sure you want to continue?
